2610.12240.title: AdaCast: Conditional Parameter Generation for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
2610.12240.paper_summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) have achieved strong forecasting performance across domains. However, most adaptation methods remain static. Existing all-in-one methods learn a single set of dataset-level parameter updates and apply the same adapted model to every input. As a result, they cannot adapt the model parameters to the temporal patterns, seasonality and dynamics of each input time series. This limits their ability to produce forecasts that are tailored to heterogeneous inputs. To address this limitation, we propose AdaCast, a conditional parameter generation framework for time-series forecasting. AdaCast uses a generator to produce input-specific low-rank parameter updates for a frozen pretrained TSFM. These updates adapt the model to each input during both training and inference. Across six public benchmarks, AdaCast consistently outperforms static adaptation baseline in in-domain forecasting and improves zero-shot generalization to held-out datasets across domains. These results demonstrate that conditional parameter generation provides an effective approach for adaptive forecasting.
2610.12240.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）在各個領域中已實現強大的預測性能。<lb/>然而，大多數適應方法仍然是靜態的。<lb/>現有的全能方法學習一組數據集級別的參數更新，並將相同的適應模型應用於每個輸入。<lb/>因此，它們無法將模型參數適應於每個輸入時間序列的時間模式、季節性和動態。<lb/>這限制了它們生成針對異質輸入的預測的能力。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了AdaCast，一種用於時間序列預測的條件參數生成框架。<lb/>AdaCast使用生成器為一個凍結的預訓練TSFM生成特定於輸入的低秩參數更新。<lb/>這些更新在訓練和推理期間使模型適應每個輸入。<lb/>在六個公共基準測試中，AdaCast在領域內預測中始終優於靜態適應基線，並改善了對各個領域中保留數據集的零樣本泛化。<lb/>這些結果表明，條件參數生成為自適應預測提供了一種有效的方法。
